notes: Not an accusation of criminal conduct. Audit exceptions are questions requiring reconciliation.

Reported allocations are not equivalent to verified expenditures or losses; may include repeat or inherited line items.
FY2021/22 is a predecessor-era baseline, even if site visits took place later.

audits.Evidence Summary: OAG identified KSh595k vehicle repair, KSh660k unsupported payment and KSh1m social-hall transfer as not qualifying/unsupported emergency expenditure.
audits.Required Cross-check: Payment vouchers, Board notification, emergency justification and any recovery/regularisation
audits.chronology_note: Legacy FY2021/22; audit site inspections occurred in 2023; do not attribute initiation to post-2022 term.

audits.Evidence Summary: OAG site visit found cracks in office walls.
audits.Required Cross-check: BoQ, contractor, completion certificate, defects-liability action and repairs
audits.chronology_note: Legacy FY2021/22; audit site inspections occurred in 2023; do not attribute initiation to post-2022 term.

audits.Evidence Summary: Two classrooms were complete/in use but veranda was chipped.
audits.Required Cross-check: BoQ/specifications, snag list and corrective works
audits.chronology_note: Legacy FY2021/22; audit site inspections occurred in 2023; do not attribute initiation to post-2022 term.

audits.Evidence Summary: OAG reported chipped floors, wall cracks and six fluorescent bulbs not fitted.
audits.Required Cross-check: BoQ, completion certificate, snag list and corrective works
audits.chronology_note: Legacy FY2021/22; audit site inspections occurred in 2023; do not attribute initiation to post-2022 term.

audits.Evidence Summary: OAG reported project complete and branded but not in use because sanitation facilities were lacking.
audits.Required Cross-check: Land/renovation records, sanitation works and actual operational date
audits.chronology_note: Legacy FY2021/22; audit site inspections occurred in 2023; do not attribute initiation to post-2022 term.

audits.Evidence Summary: OAG reported 69 proposed projects: 50 worth KSh47.598m complete and 19 worth KSh88.549m ongoing; approved code list showed 81 projects worth KSh137.089m.
audits.Required Cross-check: Reconcile implementation status against Board-approved code list project-by-project
audits.chronology_note: Legacy FY2021/22; audit site inspections occurred in 2023; do not attribute initiation to post-2022 term.

audits.Evidence Summary: Qualified-opinion issue: KSh11.184m of KSh41.093m bursaries lacked beneficiary lists; institution acknowledgement letters were not provided.
audits.Required Cross-check: Beneficiary register, institution acknowledgements, cheque schedules and vetting records
audits.source_verification: Official report located; finding needs page-level check
audits.chronology_note: Current-term FY; specific responsibility must be supported by records.

audits.Evidence Summary: Cash books, bank reconciliations and bank-balance certificates for individual PMC accounts were not provided for audit.
audits.Required Cross-check: PMC account-by-account reconciliation and bank confirmations
audits.source_verification: Official report located; finding needs page-level check
audits.chronology_note: Current-term FY; specific responsibility must be supported by records.

audits.Evidence Summary: Secondary reporting of the OAG report states one project was stalled, two deviated from BoQ specifications and another had poor workmanship. Exact project names still need extraction from the original report.
audits.Required Cross-check: Extract original OAG pages; identify four projects; trace contractors/BoQs/payment certificates
audits.source_verification: Secondary reporting; original OAG project list not checked
audits.chronology_note: Current-term FY; specific responsibility must be supported by records.

audits.Evidence Summary: National OAG summary/secondary reporting indicates Kajiado North bursary disbursements lacked approved criteria/guidelines support.
audits.Required Cross-check: Approved bursary policy, vetting criteria, minutes, beneficiary list and acknowledgements
audits.chronology_note: Current-term FY; specific responsibility must be supported by records.
audits.duplication_note: Already included in earlier 2023/24 audit summary—do not double-count.

audits.Evidence Summary: National OAG summary lists Kajiado North pending bills of KSh166,125 at 30 June 2024.
audits.Required Cross-check: Identify supplier/project, age, payment status and reason
audits.chronology_note: Current-term FY; specific responsibility must be supported by records.
audits.duplication_note: Already included in earlier 2023/24 audit summary—do not double-count.

sources.label: Lifecycle scale
sources.detail: 0 unknown; 10 proposal; 20 funds/award pending; 30 procurement; 40 groundbreaking; 50 construction; 65 substantial works; 80 completion/operation claimed; 90 handover; 100 commissioned/operating with corroboration.

sources.label: Attribution rule
sources.detail: Presence at a launch, naming/branding or a social post is not proof that an MP or NG-CDF financed the project.

sources.label: Facebook rule
sources.detail: User-supplied Hon Onesmus Ngogoyo Facebook page is a claim/timeline source. Direct historical scraping remains incomplete, so indexed posts/reposts and corroborating official/press records are captured pending post-by-post archive.
